title: Anyone interested in making AI play games?
author: Empty_Attitude608
selftext:
I've seen recent researches on making AI play games. For example, Gemini 4 Argon playing Minecraft (tho I doubt that they are capable of playing in real-time).   
  
Would it be cool to make a game where your agent acts as a Pokemon, following the trainer (user) and combat with other Pokemons?  The Pokemon agent sees screen from their viewpoint. With proper prompts and tuning, do you think they can follow you and interact in real-time?   
  
What are some limitations, assuming using small local models like Gemma 4 E2B/E4B?
